reviews.t: Great for thick African American hair!
reviews.x: I'll cut straight to the chase: If you are African American with difficult to manage hair, I highly recommend this product! I'm not here to be PC because PC reviews are why it took me so long to find what I was looking for. I have really thick hair that is a nightmare to comb after taking braids down. Picture eight flexible combs that seem to contour to the texture of your hair as you comb through it, and that's what this is. I don't know who thought of this but I'm glad they did because I was O

reviews.t: WHAT ARE YOU WAITING FOR? GET IT NOW! 4C, YES!
reviews.x: I'm shocked this actually works. Not only on 4c hair but also on 3b hair and 4a hair.  What single strand knots? What tangles? I can not believe I got all our hair brushed in under 10 minutes. It usually takes me an entire day to detangle my 4c hair. I went back with my denman and fine tooth comb and sure enough,  my hair was thoroughly detangled. I can't recommend this enough. go get you one NOW!

I am not the kind who rates products often but I was so impressed with this brush!!  We are 5 weeks into the Coronavirus lock down and I am not accustomed to doing my own hair.  This brush made it very easy to detangle my natural hair that I normally press/curl.  Now I am embracing my curls and loving the process - thank you for a product that actually does what it says!!

Best detangling brush out there. I'm a Latina with a lot of curly hair.  I'm loving this brush, I just bought 2 other ones. One for my daughter and her cousin. It's so easy to use, I'll just pass the brush twice in one section of my hair and move on the other sections and I'm done quickly.

Products looks great, just as described and pictured. Also arrived before the estimated date. I bought one for myself and the other two as gift for my friends. I hope they like it. I am yet to use it so I will give updates later

I’m usually not one to leave first impression reviews but I do want to give this first impression. I have 4C high density hair so there’s a lot of it. I never detangle dry and do it either under water or with product. If you have high density hair you know you can’t just go into it without smaller sections but when I did I noticed how smooth and fast it went. I’ve detangled with (and broken) denman brushes previously but it took a lot more force to get through whereas this glided which I think i

I’d say my hair type is a mixture of 3a-3b. my hair also comes to the middle of my back, so take thickness and length into consideration when reading this. This brush has cut my detangling in half. Where before it would take me 45 mins to detangle it now takes me about 25 mins. It’s definitely worth it if detangling takes you a long time and you’re looking to cut this time down. Don’t forget to use a deep conditioner (or styler) and lots of water to help detangle you curls safely. All in all a g
It works, but is awkward in that the bristles can come off the base.

It’s a dream for extremely “kinky” tight curls to combine this brush use after spraying the Honest Conditioning Detangler. I wrapped my hair with a towel to deepen the conditioner. And sprayed another round: and then I used the rat tooth comb to undo cornrow braids and it was like “butter”. And then using this detangling brush was a dream. No pain or discomfort. And m

reviews.t: Great tool for anyone with natural hair 3a/3b/3c/4a/4b/4c
reviews.x: I've seen this brush on Instagram, Twitter and YouTube so I had to try it for myself. I had a bit of difficulty when I tried to use it on damp hair, but once I got into the shower and added conditioner it just glided through my hair effortlessly. The brush itself is pretty big and has the soft matte grip handle that fits perfectly in your hand, I also love how it stimulates the scalp.

I used this for a couple washes to get a fair feel for what the brush is like. I’ve never used the original, but this definitely doesn’t de tangle my hair as well as other detangling combs/brushes (wet brush for coarse hair is my fav). My hair is 3b/3c and I struggled, even with loads of conditioner. I can’t imagine this working well on 4c hair types. Pass on this one.

New fave to my hair regimen. I have 4c hair and already own a denman brush and other detangling brushes. I still use them but I prefer this as a first defense to get big tangles out as it expands and flexes so I don't have to use much force to get the brush through. And the rattail comb is just a plus. very sturdy.

I purchased this item because well... my quarantine hair needed help!! I needed something to untangle braids and tangoes and this did the job well. I used the end of the rat tail comb mostly but the brush is a nice added bonus to brush my thick hair tangle free without causing a lot of damage.
this brush is awesome! i have 4C-4D hair (LOL) and it’s untangles my hair perfectly! I highly recommend for all natural hair types.

I got this set for my daughter's 3b hair. She was able to detangle her hair in 5 minutes, a project that usually take her an hour or more. Since she does her detangling in the shower, this brush probably paid for itself in water saved the first time she used it. After using the detangler, her hair looked healthier and shinier than it ever has before. I am a happy customer! She liked the comb too, but that detangler was a live changer.

reviews.t: Love the comb, not the brush so much...
reviews.x: I have thick wavy hair. I usually detangle in the shower. I wouldn't recommend this brush for anyone with similar hair just because I find it pulls my hair rather than detangles it. It may work on other hair textures just doesn't work for mine. I do love the comb it comes with and have used it everyday since buying. The set is good for the price either way.

reviews.t: The best detangling brush I’ve bought
reviews.x: I absolutely love this brush! It does wonders for my curls and does not cause shedding. It makes my detangling process so much easier and It’s very sturdy to the point where I don’t even have to use the extra tool that came with it. The price is the icing on the cake. I would definitely recommend!

The brush itself is so nice it goes through my hair perfectly and makes my curls look nice and makes them go to the actual form of a curl if that makes sense, the comb that comes with it is super nice and is one of the best rat tail combs i’ve ever had:)

It’s been hard to find a brush or comb that works on my daughters hair and I’ve tried a lot I finally broke down and got one of these and I recommended it to a friend and she went and  got one and her daughter loves it as well

This brush and comb are perfect. The brush makes it so easy to brush through my daughters tight curls. The comb is excellent to help style. They are great solid quality and easy to clean. Definitely will be purchasing again.
The only thing I dislike is the piece that holds the combs in place will pop off if you dont hold it correctly. Other than that it goes through my thick hair, wet or dry, with no issues.
[[VIDEOID:5d05244acda6f76299884f80491ab14]] Me encantó creo que ha sido una excelente inversión, ahora será mi cepillo favorito porque desenreda muy bien mi cabello sin maltratar.
got this for my baby bc she needed something that helped with managing her hair on wash day. i also love the comb it came with as well. and it has a great durability & longevity.
I have thick curly hair and so do my girls so this makes doing our hair a breeze. Well at least when it comes to detangling and parting. It’s great for tender headed people.
So far these brushes are great. I haven’t had any problems with them at all. They very sturdy especially the rat tail comb. Love that I was able to get two items in one!

claims.text: Reviewers with curly and coily hair types, including 3a-4c, widely report that the brush detangles quickly and effectively.
Many reviewers say the brush significantly cuts their detangling time, often from an hour or more down to minutes.
Several reviewers mention buying multiple brushes for family or friends, or that it arrived as described and before the estimated date.
A few reviewers note drawbacks: the bristles can come off the base, and it may not detangle as well as other brushes for some hair types.
Some reviewers note it works best on damp hair with conditioner or a detangler rather than dry.
